name: Should I keep my existing kitchen layout or reconfigure the floor plan?

mainEntity.name: Should I keep my existing kitchen layout or reconfigure the floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between keeping or reconfiguring your kitchen layout involves balancing budget against functionality. Keeping the existing layout preserves sink, stove, and refrigerator positions, which saves on plumbing, electrical, and gas line rerouting. This approach maximizes your budget for upgraded custom cabinetry, premium countertops, and high-end finishes. However, if your current footprint suffers from poor traffic flow, cramped prep zones, or isolation from adjoining living areas, reconfiguring into an open-concept design or adding an island provides long-term daily usability that new surfaces alone cannot fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keeping your layout saves on plumbing and electrical work, freeing budget for finishes. Reconfiguring solves poor workflow, clears bottlenecks, or creates an open-concept space.
